note: Mined 2026-10-08 from Bergson, Freud, Attardo. Reusable situation seeds for premise mining: each names a situation with built-in contradiction and room to develop. Shape mirrors figgsite premise packs; staged for templates/premises/.

territories.seed: A lost-and-chased object (hat, letter, package) accumulates holders and returns to its owner eaten or spent.
Divorce and remarriage bureaucracy where the escape procedure delivers the same people back in worse roles.
Trade-jargon tribunal: plumber, priest, or dev-ops describes love and death strictly in work tickets.
Unwanted portrait or award ceremony where the critic asked for praise must deliver insult safely.
Marriage-broker forced to oversell a defective lot while the truth leaks automatically.
Bath or cleanliness boaster, or gourmet caught with low pleasure, defending via philosophy.
Job interview garden-pathing from merit test to lecherous-boss script until the punch reframes the shortlist.
Office shorthand scene where the backgrounded stereotype does the work; spelling it out would kill it.
Bar bet with a talking dog where the backgrounded impossibility is ignored and the punch is a deadpan correction.
